note: A dropped event is allowed to be silent about nothing. Each SDK writes one rate-limited line naming the likely cause and the fix; `kind` is the rate-limiting bucket (a hot loop of one failure costs one line) and `hint_contains` is the load-bearing part of the sentence. Messages must stay ASCII: they land in whatever console the host app has, and a cp1252 Windows terminal turns a stray em dash into mojibake.

diagnostics.name: network-unreachable
diagnostics.why: No status at all: the request never reached a server. Blaming the payload here would send the user hunting for the wrong bug.
hint_contains: Is a LightTrack server running and reachable at
Events are dropped while it is unreachable.

diagnostics.name: 400-without-a-project
diagnostics.why: The first-run trap reached the slow way: an ADMIN key passes the preflight check (a key is set) and the server does the rejecting, because an admin key pins no project.
hint_contains: The server has no project for this event.
an admin key does not imply a project.

diagnostics.name: 400-with-a-project
diagnostics.why: Same status, different cause. With a project attached the payload is what is wrong.
hint_contains: The event was rejected as invalid: check provider / model / usage.

diagnostics.name: 401-without-a-key
diagnostics.why: No key at all is a different fix from a bad key, and the message has to say which.
hint_contains: This server requires authentication. Set LIGHTTRACK_KEY to a project API key.

diagnostics.name: 403-behaves-like-401
hint_contains: This server requires authentication. Set LIGHTTRACK_KEY to a project API key.

diagnostics.name: 404-wrong-url
diagnostics.why: The Python SDK's 404 branch interpolated an undefined name, so composing this one message raised NameError inside the diagnostic - the reporter becoming the failure it reports. It also used an em dash where the other two use a hyphen.

diagnostics.name: 429-over-a-limit
hint_contains: The project is over a configured usage limit, so ingest is being refused.

diagnostics.name: 500-server-error
hint_contains: The LightTrack server errored; events are dropped until it recovers.

diagnostics.name: 503-server-error
hint_contains: The LightTrack server errored; events are dropped until it recovers.
